subject: MATHEMATICS
title: The 100-Place Parade
objective: Identify ordinal positions through 100th from a stated start and direction.
introduction: Milo is watching a parade! Help him name each marcher's position: first, second, and all the way to one hundredth.

vocabulary.definition: A symbol or word that tells how many, like 25.
The position of a person or thing in a line-up.
A row of people or things counted from a starting point.

items.prompt: Which statement about ordinal numbers is true?

options.text: Ordinal numbers show position, and the starting point and direction must be clear.

items.explanation: Ordinal numbers like 1st and 25th name a position. You also need to know where counting starts and which way it goes.

items.prompt: Which names the position of the first child in line?

options.text: Counting from the middle of the line

items.explanation: 1st names the first position. '25 children' is a count, not a position.

items.prompt: Which is NOT an ordinal number?
items.explanation: 25th and 1st name positions in a line. A plain 25 only tells how many, so it is not an ordinal number.

items.prompt: A line is counted left to right. What follows 24th?
items.explanation: Counting left to right, the position right after 24th is 25th.
100th names the one-hundredth position in a line, so it is an ordinal number.
